items.q: Is the banana rave really live?
items.a: Yes — every banana is a real visitor, right now. A quiet floor is honesty, not failure. Bring a friend.

items.q: Why does everyone dance in perfect sync?
items.a: One song, one wall clock, the whole planet on the same beat. Oldest trick in the club.

items.q: Do I need an account to join the rave?
items.a: No account and no cost. Your banana walks in dressed the way you left it in [the builder](/make-a-banana/), or a fresh one is made for you.
The gauge of the night — everything you grab fills it. Full, it flashes: tap it and the floor drops, just for you.
Your standing, 1 to 99, forever — synced across devices on [your pass](/pass/). Titles land at the big levels, in gold on the roster.

items.q: Where do the rave’s wearable drops come from?
items.a: People draw them in [the Items Workshop](/forge/items/). Approved ones drop here with the maker’s name riding them.
Everything — onto [your pass](/pass/), into [the builder](/make-a-banana/), and everywhere your banana goes.
